A Cauchy-Euler equation with forcing takes the form

Content:

To find the particular solution to a Cauchy-Euler equation with polynomial forcing, we assume that the terms of a particular solution are proportional to the terms of [MATH: f.]

where [MATH: f(x) = 2x^3 - 5x,] we would assume that a particular solution takes the form

Content:
[MATH: y_p(x) = \alpha x^3 + \beta x.]
